name: China National Software & Service Company Limited
summary: China National Software & Service Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides basic software and core application solutions in China and internationally. The company offers Galaxy Kylin desktop, Galaxy Kylin advanced server, and Starlight Kylin operating systems; and DM8 database management system, DM distributed database, database appliance DAMENG PAI, Dameng Qiyun database cloud service system, and GDMBASE.
